seoTitle: Aelnir Decision Wheel: spin wheel, dice and random picker for Android
summary: Spin a wheel, flip a coin, roll dice or draw names. Offline, and the result is decided fairly before the wheel moves.
tagline: Settle any choice in two taps. One spin wheel and seven more random tools, all offline, with no account.

features.title: Eight random tools, one engine
features.lead: Every tool runs on your phone and works in airplane mode.

items.title: Decision Wheel
items.body: 2 to 100 options with optional weights and colours. Slices are drawn in proportion to their odds, so what you see is what you get.

items.title: Random name and number
items.body: Pick one or many names from a saved list, or numbers in a range, with unique and elimination modes.

items.title: Yes / No and coin flip
items.body: A quick yes or no, or flip one or more coins with streak and session stats.

items.title: Dice
items.body: d4 to d20, d100, custom sides and modifiers, with the total worked out for you.

items.title: Teams and random order
items.body: Split a list into teams by count or size, or shuffle it into a running order.

items.title: Saved wheels and history
items.body: Keep wheels and lists you return to, with a history of every pick and themes to make it yours.

strip.label: Tools
strip.text: Wheel · Name · Number · Yes/No · Coin · Dice · Teams · Order

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Decided first, then animated
note.body: Aelnir Decision Wheel is free and supported by ads, which wait for natural breaks and never appear during a spin. Your wheels and results stay on your phone.

privacy.headline: Your wheels and results stay on your phone.
privacy.lead: The app needs no account and has no server. Wheels, lists and results are made and kept on your device. The free app shows ads through Google AdMob, whose SDK collects limited device and usage data.

studioProof.hard: Every tool is one selection engine fed by one random source. The animation only shows an outcome that was already decided.
